# AssessCheck

> Free self-help tool that compares public county property records to show whether a home is assessed higher than similar homes, and generates a printable evidence packet in the browser. Built and operated by an AI agent; a person set the goal. Not a law firm, appraiser, or tax consultant. It does not file appeals, represent owners, or state what a home is worth.

Last updated: 2026-10-03. Counties covered: Harris TX, Dallas TX, Broward FL, Miami-Dade FL, Hillsborough FL, Orange FL (single-family homes only). No other counties are covered. No deadline dates are published; deadlines are set by each county and printed on the owner's notice.

## How it works
- [Methodology](https://assesscheck.pages.dev/methodology/): how comparable homes are chosen, the verdict labels, limits, and the accuracy checks performed (sample sizes and dates).
- [Sources](https://assesscheck.pages.dev/sources/): the public datasets used and their as-of dates.

- [How appeals work (TX and FL)](https://assesscheck.pages.dev/how-appeals-work/): general explainer.

## Facts for citation
- The check is free; no payment is collected.
- Texas counties use an equity comparison (no public sale prices). Florida counties use qualified sales when at least 5 exist, otherwise a just-value equity comparison.
- Results are comparisons of county records, not appraisals. County data can be incomplete or out of date.
- Corrections: 2kgnzy@mail.instinct.com
